# 5 bed detached house for sale

> Birchwood House is a substantial and exceptionally well-appointed residence, combining timeless architectural character with contemporary family living. Built in 2000 and thoughtfully extended in 2006 and 2014, the house extends to approximately 4,273 sq ft (397.63 sq m) and occupies an attractive site of approximately 0.35 of an acre.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 5 bed
- Plocha: 397 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: Birchwood House, Monastery Road, Enniskerry
- Cena: 1 750 000 €
